headline: Administrative review for reasonable accommodations for land use and zoning regulations for individuals with disabilities.
summary: The meeting will discuss an administrative review of reasonable accommodations under land use and zoning regulations for individuals with disabilities. No other business is listed on the agenda.
items: Administrative review for reasonable accommodations for land use and zoning regulations for individuals with disabilities.
location: City Council Chambers, 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 2nd Floor

City of Salem, Massachusetts 
Office of the City Clerk 
 
 Maureen Elizabeth Fisher 
City Clerk 
 
 
 
 
October 28, 2026 
 
 
MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA 
 
The City Council Committee on Ordinances, Licenses and Legal Affairs co-posted with 
the Committee of the Whole will meet in person on Monday November 16, 2026, at 6:00 
PM for the purpose of discussing an Administrative review for reasonable 
accommodations for land use and zoning regulations for individuals with disabilities. 
This meeting will be held in the City Council Chambers. 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 
2nd Floor.

AGENDA
